plugins.name: model-keys
plugins.description: Pick model and effort with ctrl+alt+arrows or a click, plus a context usage bar and breakdown pane

plugins.name: no-self-clone
plugins.description: Stops the planner from spawning copies of itself: subagents, forks and workflow agents must run on a cheaper model

plugins.name: prompt-sharpen
plugins.description: Rewrites each prompt you send to be more explicit before Claude reads it

plugins.name: strict-prose
plugins.description: Enforces plain house writing rules on every file, commit, post and copy reply: no em dashes, hype words, emoji or stock AI phrasing

plugins.name: subagent-model
plugins.description: Shows the model and effort level of the session and each running subagent, nested, below the prompt bar
